006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import java.time.Duration;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.regex.Matcher;
011import java.util.regex.Pattern;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDayTimeDurationItem;
015import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
016import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
017import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
019
020/**
021 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
022 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#day-time-duration">day-time-duration</a>
023 * data type.
024 */
025public class DayTimeAdapter
026    extends AbstractDurationAdapter<Duration, IDayTimeDurationItem> {
027  @NonNull
028  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
029      List.of(
030          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "day-time-duration")));
031
032  private static final Pattern DAY_TIME_DURATION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
033      "^(?<sign>-)?"
034          + "P"
035          + "(?:(?<day>[0-9]+)D)?"
036          + "(?:T"
037          + "(?:(?<hour>[0-9]+)H)?"
038          + "(?:(?<minute>[0-9]+)M)?"
039          + "(?:(?<second2>[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
040          + ")?$");
041
042  DayTimeAdapter() {
043    super(Duration.class, IDayTimeDurationItem.class, IDayTimeDurationItem::cast);
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
048    return NAMES;
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public Duration copy(Object obj) {
053    // value in immutable
054    return (Duration) obj;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public Duration parse(String value) {
059    Matcher matcher = DAY_TIME_DURATION_PATTERN.matcher(value);
060
061    if (!matcher.matches()) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
063          String.format("String duration '%s' is not a day/time duration.", value));
064    }
065
066    try {
067      return parseDuration(
068          matcher.group(1) != null,
069          matcher.group(2),
070          matcher.group(3),
071          matcher.group(4),
072          matcher.group(5));
073    } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
074      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
075          String.format("Invalid duration value '%s'.", value),
076          ex);
077    }
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  public IDayTimeDurationItem newItem(Object value) {
082    Duration item = toValue(value);
083    return IDayTimeDurationItem.valueOf(item);
084  }
085}
